thread.text:
Today: Incline Bench Press led at 70kg instead of the prescribed 67.5kg, landing 5,5,5 at the bottom of the band before a strong 50kg×10 back-off — matches the "felt strong" note. Pull-ups followed the same pattern, pushing to +10kg for 7,7 before dropping to bodyweight for 8; total reps came in under the 24 you ran at +5kg on 11-12. Chest Fly hit 10,10,10 at 65kg, the first clean top-of-band set on all three since the stall broke on 09-28. Reverse Fly also jumped unprescribed to 47.5kg for 10,10 before settling back to 42.5kg×10. Lateral Raise stayed on script at 8kg×15,15,15, and One Handed Triceps Pull hit 12,12,12 at 10kg for the first time.

Heart rate: Today ran 64 minutes start to end, in line with the week's other lifting sessions (57, 67, 35 min), but peaked at 150bpm — well above last week's 139, 140, 139 highs, tracking with the heavier pushes on incline and pull-ups. Average sat at 105, matching 11-15's 105, with the trace climbing to 115 within the first ten minutes then settling into the high 90s-low 100s for the rest — a session front-loaded with its hardest lifting.

Sleep: 8h05 before this session, HRV 139ms, 42bpm average asleep — well above the 4-night average HRV of 102ms. No 28-night normal yet to measure against, but that strong night lines up with the "felt strong" note and the heavier loading across incline, pull-ups and reverse fly.

Trend: Incline's 70kg×5,5,5 is a self-directed jump past the 67.5kg prescription; it's within the 5-8 band but sitting at the floor, not the 8s that would lock 70kg in for good — worth watching whether Thursday carries any residual fatigue from it. Lateral Raise has read 15-16 reps across six sessions now (09-21 through today) without reaching the 20 needed for 9kg — the longest stall in the log. One Handed Triceps Pull's 12,12,12 is the first top-of-band session; one more like it earns the next increment.

Next session: Upper B, Thu 19 Nov. Deadlift at 80kg for 3×5 — one more clean set like 11-05's 5,5,5 earns 82.5kg. Pull-ups go second at bodyweight. The Iso-Lateral Row steps up to 42.5kg after three clean 10,10,10 sets at 40kg on 11-14.
